name: ESA NanoTech
verdict: Part of LMDV Capital, the investment company founded by Leonardo Maria Del Vecchio. Nothing found.
note: New livery sponsor of AF Corse's #83 Ferrari 499P for the 2026 FIA WEC season; its logo is on the side and front of the car (esananotech.com announcement).
